payload.blocks: Phase 1 of plan 261119-1142-supervisor-live-run is still unable to start its unit.
payload.headline: fgos run still refused after the route fix; my session may predate it

parts.cause: Most likely this head session's request socket is served by the host that started before the fix, so it still rewrites argv the old way; unproven. Nothing else changed: the worktree .../261119-1142-supervisor-live-run-p01 is unused and the plan is running with phase 1 ready.

options.does: The supervisor restarts this lead head so its socket uses the active release; I resume from the plan file and rerun phase 1.
options.gain: Tests the real fix on the live path.
options.harm: A session restart, which only the supervisor may do.
options.label: Restart my session

options.cost: One plan-directory file plus one land.
options.does: I write a unit file in the plan directory and run `fgos run --unit <file>`.
options.harm: Does not prove the fix; I do not know the unit file format.
options.label: Use --unit file

parts.recommendation: Restart my session (first option) so the fix is proven on the path the live run exists to test.

scope.allows: A supervisor restart of this head, or an approved --unit workaround; I then rerun phase 1 and land it.
scope.forbids: I will not start or stop sessions myself, write outside the plan directory, or run the unit with Bash.

parts.what: After the answer 'Fix the route' (fix 530050e8e said to be in the active release) I reran the identical `fgos run` call. It failed again with exit 4, the same 'requires --unit, a prompt, or --sync' error (ticket c-9994-1795097623762). The argv still shows `run --json <prompt> --writes ...`.
